description: Delete a link and its stats for good. The short address stops working and cannot be used again. This cannot be undone, so confirm with the person first. To keep the stats, use archive_link instead.

code.description: The link's code (the part after siz.la/) or its full short address. Give either id or code.

id.description: The link's id, as returned by list_links or shorten_link. Give either id or code.

name: delete_link
title: Delete a link
